# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old, later growing into a young lady  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden  <sub>[v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face, a snubbed nose, and a very wide smile. In her younger years, her hair was worn in innumerable plaits with prominent blue ribbon bows that seemed to be everywhere at once. Upon blossoming into young ladyhood, she discarded the blue bows and began wearing her hair in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 c3 P37](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a cheerful, warm-hearted, and brisk girl who is completely devoted to her mistress. She works with vim and energy, never complaining or showing judgment when her mistress indulges in imaginative play. She is extremely open with her feelings, easily worried about those she loves, and maintains an enthusiastic, sincere admiration for her friends.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_

## Goals

- To serve and care for her mistress, Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- To avoid acquiring an American accent while living in Boston  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>

## History

Charlotta came to live as a handmaiden at Echo Lodge for Miss Lavendar Lewis at fourteen years of age, following her three older sisters who had worked there before her. She assisted Miss Lavendar faithfully with household tasks, gardening, and preparations for her mistress's wedding to Stephen Irving. Following the wedding, she moved to Boston with Mr. and Mrs. Irving, though she initially suffered from severe homesickness and preferred Prince Edward Island. During subsequent summers, she returned with the Irvings to Echo Lodge, having grown into a young lady. She later married an American bricklayer named Tom. She traveled back to the Island to attend Anne Shirley's wedding, enthusiastically throwing rice and old shoes as the newlyweds departed.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010), [v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora, but she is called Charlotta the Fourth as the last of four Bowman sisters who served Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She came to live with Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge for board and clothes when she was fourteen  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She married an American bricklayer named Tom  <sub>[v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m real glad of that. They said I did at home, but I thought likely they just wanted to aggravate me. I don’t want no Yankee accent. Not that I’ve a word to say against the Yankees, Miss Shirley, ma’am. They’re real civilized. But give me old P.E. Island every time.  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>

> Goodness, no, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I wouldn’t know who he meant if he did. Of course, when we got married he had to say, 'I take thee, Leonora,’ and I declare to you, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’ve had the most dreadful feeling ever since that it wasn’t me he was talking to and I haven’t been rightly married at all. And so you’re going to be married yourself, Miss Shirley, ma’am? I always thought I’d like to marry a doctor. It would be so handy when the children had measles and croup. Tom is only a bricklayer, but he’s real good-tempered. When I said to him, says I, 'Tom, can I go to Miss Shirley’s wedding? I mean to go anyhow, but I’d like to have your consent,’ he just says, 'Suit yourself, Charlotta, and you’ll suit me.’ That’s a real pleasant kind of husband to have, Miss Shirley, ma’am.  <sub>[v4 c3 P42](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0042)</sub>
